source.title: New WQAC Leader (December 2019)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Committee Leader. Daniel Vædele Egdal will become the new Leader of the WCA Quality Assurance Committee (WQAC). Daniel was already working as a member of the WQAC.
<!-- break -->
Daniel was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote among the current Committee Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our [Motion 10.2019.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams.

The new Leader will be promoted immediately. You can view his candidacy document [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1MuvxQaSV2s9MKPfSW_m0p3q3nTDQNDqb?usp=sharing).

translation.title: WCA 质量保证委员会新任负责人（2019 年 12 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，Daniel Vædele Egdal 将担任 WCA 质量保证委员会（WQAC）的新任负责人。Daniel 此前已是 WQAC 成员。

依照 WCA 委员会与团队[动议 10.2019.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节，WCA 董事会选定 Daniel，并经现任委员会负责人和高级代表投票批准。

新负责人将立即上任。他的申请材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1MuvxQaSV2s9MKPfSW_m0p3q3nTDQNDqb?usp=sharing)查看。
